rules.name: SQL Injection Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in HTTP requests including UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, and comment-based injection
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "sql" or Message contains "injection" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG07-001

rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "cross" or Message contains "site" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG07-002
